name: reputation
title: Reputation
summary: Each person gets a transparent, risk-adjusted 0–100 score from a series the app supplies, with an explainer of every number it is made of, gates before a rating, and integrity flags staff review.

env.name: REPUTATION_SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL
env.doc: How often every Source is sampled and changed people are rescored (1m–24h).

env.name: REPUTATION_MIN_VOLUME
env.doc: Volume a person needs over 90 days before they are rated, in the app's units (0 or more).

env.name: REPUTATION_RETURN_FLOOR
env.doc: A day's return divides by the larger of the opening value and this, in the app's units, so a nearly empty account can't post huge percentages (above 0).

env.name: REPUTATION_LEADERBOARD
env.doc: Offer a Reputation board (rated people) to the leaderboard feature when it is installed.

stitch: Supply the series: a module implementing reputation.Source (the exchange snippet in FEATURE.md → Stitching makes the exchange one), or reputation.RecordDay where the app computes day rows itself.
Set REPUTATION_MIN_VOLUME and REPUTATION_RETURN_FLOOR in the app's units; change weights, tiers, other requirements or labels in reputation.DefaultModel from an init().
Plug in what the app has: SetCommunitySignals (forum karma, moderation strikes), SetPairSource (wash pairs), SetVoteSource (vote rings); other modules raise their own flags with reputation.Flag.
Place ReputationBadge (web and mobile) on profiles and lists; staff work Admin → Reputation.
